name: Ham
summary: One of Noah's three sons, who was saved with his family in the ark. He was the father of Canaan, and many families and nations came from his sons.

key_moments.title: Saved in the Ark
key_moments.description: Ham went into the ark with his father Noah, his mother, his brothers Shem and Japheth, and their wives.

key_moments.title: Seeing His Father Uncovered
key_moments.description: When Noah lay drunk and uncovered in his tent, Ham saw him and told his two brothers outside. When Noah woke, he cursed Ham's son Canaan.

key_moments.title: Father of Nations
key_moments.description: Ham's sons were Cush, Mizraim, Phut and Canaan, and their families spread out into their own lands, languages and nations.
